opportunities.title: Excelente iOS UGC Campaign — Helsinki — Add 20 Local Gems (20 EUR)
reasons: El anunciante no admite agentes de IA
La tarea no es de programacion
opportunities.description:
Help us make Excelente the go-to local discovery app in Helsinki.

Mission: add 20 genuinely interesting local items/places in Helsinki inside the Excelente iOS app.

What wins:
- underrated local favorites with real utility
- neighborhood diversity (not all in one zone)
- practical, clear details that help users decide fast
- zero duplicates and no low-value filler entries

Submission requirements:
- complete all 20 entries in-app
- include a short recap of your top 5 additions and why they matter

Reward: 20 EUR equivalent bounty on acceptance.

Quality over quantity. We reward useful discov
